decisions.site: Milburn Landing Area public boat ramp and kayak launch
decisions.reason: Maryland DNR feature 333 / facility 473 identifies Pocomoke State Park - Milburn Landing on the Pocomoke River and marks ramp and kayak/canoe launch present. This is the managed access-site anchor, not a surveyed ramp edge.

BLM Upper Owyhee guidance says the 45 Ranch cherrystem requires landowner permission. It was removed from the route access list. South Fork Pipeline road/staging status and a lawful river-right landing at the East Fork confluence remain unverified.

decisions.site: Parks / Cecil Rousseau Poche Memorial Park
decisions.reason: Page 15 of the Bayou Teche Paddle Trail Plan publishes the Parks motorboat launch at 30°12.813′N, 91°49.746′W. The current TECHE dock directory corroborates the named park dock. The plan coordinate is an access anchor, not a current surveyed dock edge.

decisions.site: Cricket Park / Greystone Mill Pond launch
decisions.reason: ExploreRI publishes 41°51.966′N, 71°29.578′W and describes a hand-carried launch beyond the playground. WRWC independently confirms a Cricket Park boat launch. The pin is an access-area anchor, not a surveyed water-entry edge.

newCoordinates.feature: River Valley Park paddling access WA-835

decisions.reason: The previous point conflated the 13th Street play feature with the park launch. Iowa Whitewater identifies the dam feature; current Iowa DNR feature OBJECTID 39216 / WA-835 identifies River Valley Park. Trip details now use the points for their distinct meanings.

Current Iowa DNR feature OBJECTID 40228 / WA-630 identifies Massillon Area as a boat ramp. Updated the optional intermediate-access point; route endpoints Oxford Mills and Syracuse are unchanged, so no route hold is needed for this site.

The Friends of the Verde River access guide publishes this coordinate. Retained the supported point but removed the claim that it is the exact water-entry edge. No correction or route hold was justified.

Available coordinates identify the hamlet/area, not a current town- or manager-verified public launch. American Whitewater establishes named river sections but does not verify public landing, parking, or carry at this point. The access was relabeled and routes withheld.

decisions.site: New Bethlehem kayak launch below the dam
decisions.reason: RVTA identifies 41.0024,-79.3322 as the municipal parking lot and separately describes the Gumtown Park kayak launch, without publishing its launch-edge coordinate. Updated names and evidence to distinguish parking from water entry.

NPS Getting Around publishes this coordinate for Ozark Campground. The campground map labels a separate River Access symbol but gives no coordinates for it. Route and trip-detail names now make clear that campground GPS is not the water-entry point.
